sections.heading: Tom Hiddleston — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Tom Hiddleston was born on 9 February 1981 in Westminster, and holds British nationality. He was given the name Thomas William Hiddleston at birth and is publicly known as Tom Hiddleston.
Public records name his father, James Norman Hiddleston and his mother, Diana Patricia Servaes. He is a sibling of Emma Hiddleston.
His listed education includes Eton College, University of Cambridge, Royal Academy of Dramatic Art and Pembroke College.
He is recorded as speaking English.
